Turkish · 1,000 words

Turkish words 901–1000

Turkish words 901 to 1000, by how often they're used, each with its meaning in English, an example sentence and, for verbs, the main forms (he, she or it). 50 of them are taught in the lessons of the course.

Learn them with spaced repetition, Anki-style: open the flashcards. Free, no account needed.

Overview1–100101–200201–300301–400401–500501–600601–700701–800801–900901–1000
  1. 901
    gerçekleşmekverb

    to come true; to happen, to take place

    Sonunda hayalim gerçekleşti!

    My dream has finally come true!

    aorist gerçekleşir · present gerçekleşiyor · past gerçekleşti · future gerçekleşecek

    From gerçek (real) + -lAş. Formal for events: Toplantı yarın gerçekleşecek (The meeting will take place tomorrow).

    B1

  2. 902
    çarpmakverb

    to hit, to crash into, to bump into; to multiply; to beat fast (the heart)

    Araba bir ağaca çarptı.

    The car crashed into a tree.

    aorist çarpar · present çarpıyor · past çarptı · future çarpacak

    What is hit takes the dative: duvara çarpmak. In arithmetic, to multiply: İki çarpı üç altı eder (Two times three is six). A heart çarpar when it races.

    B1

  3. 903
    üçüncünumber

    third

    Bu ay üçüncü kez geç kaldın!

    That's the third time you've been late this month!

    Üç + -(I)ncI. Üçüncü olmak = to come third.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 11: Numbers and time

  4. 904
    generalnoun

    general (army)

    General askerlere emir verdi.

    The general gave the soldiers orders.

    accusative generali

    Takes front-vowel suffixes, like saat: generali, generaller. Soldiers address an officer as Komutanım.

    B1

  5. 905
    sarmakverb

    to wrap; to surround; to grab, to hook (colloquial)

    Hediyeyi güzel bir kâğıda sardım.

    I wrapped the present in nice paper.

    aorist sarar · present sarıyor · past sardı · future saracak

    What you wrap it in takes the dative: kâğıda sarmak. Colloquially, to grab your interest: Bu dizi beni sardı (I'm hooked on this show). Sarılmak = to hug.

    B1

  6. 906
    doldurmakverb

    to fill, to fill up; to fill out, to fill in (a form)

    Lütfen bu formu doldurun.

    Please fill out this form.

    aorist doldurur · present dolduruyor · past doldurdu · future dolduracak

    Causative of dolmak (to become full). Bardağı suyla doldurdu = He filled the glass with water.

    A2

  7. 907
    öğretmennoun

    teacher

    Bizim öğretmenimiz çok sabırlı.

    Our teacher is very patient.

    From öğretmek (to teach). Pupils call their teacher Öğretmenim or Hocam.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 3: Saying who you are

  8. 908
    dertnoun

    trouble, worry, problem; grief, sorrow

    Derdin ne? Neden bu kadar sessizsin?

    What's wrong? Why are you so quiet?

    accusative derdi

    The t becomes d before a vowel: derdi, derdim. Dert etme = Don't worry about it; dertli = troubled.

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 4: Ottoman, Arabic and Persian structures

  9. 909
    umutnoun

    hope

    Hâlâ umut var, pes etme.

    There's still hope; don't give up.

    accusative umudu

    The t becomes d before a vowel: umudu, umudum. Umut etmek = to hope; umarım (from ummak) = I hope. Synonym: ümit.

    B1

  10. 910
    düşürmekverb

    to drop; to bring down, to lower (a price, a fever); to make (someone) fall

    Telefonumu yine düşürdüm.

    I dropped my phone again.

    aorist düşürür · present düşürüyor · past düşürdü · future düşürecek

    Causative of düşmek (to fall). Ateşi düşürmek = to bring a fever down; fiyatı düşürmek = to lower the price.

    B1

  11. 911
    uykunoun

    sleep; sleepiness

    Uykum geldi, ben yatıyorum.

    I'm sleepy; I'm going to bed.

    From uyumak (to sleep). Uykum var or Uykum geldi = I'm sleepy; uykusuz = sleepless; İyi uykular = Sleep well.

    A2

  12. 912
    kanıtlamakverb

    to prove

    Bunu kanıtlayabilir misin?

    Can you prove it?

    aorist kanıtlar · present kanıtlıyor · past kanıtladı · future kanıtlayacak

    From kanıt (proof, evidence) + -lA. The a becomes ı before -(I)yor: kanıtlıyor. What is proved is often a noun clause: haklı olduğunu kanıtlamak.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 4: Noun clauses

  13. 913
    şarapnoun

    wine

    Bir kadeh kırmızı şarap alabilir miyim?

    Could I have a glass of red wine?

    accusative şarabı

    The p becomes b before a vowel: şarabı. Beyaz şarap = white wine; kadeh = wine glass.

    A2

  14. 914
    sürpriznoun

    surprise

    Sana bir sürprizim var!

    I have a surprise for you!

    Sürpriz yapmak = to surprise someone (dative); sürpriz parti = surprise party. To be surprised is şaşırmak.

    A2

  15. 915
    renknoun

    colour

    Bu elbisenin rengi çok güzel.

    The colour of this dress is lovely.

    accusative rengi

    The k becomes g before a vowel: rengi. Ne renk? = What colour? Renkli = colourful.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 2: Vowel harmony and plurals

  16. 916
    çaynoun

    tea

    Bir çay daha içer misin?

    Will you have another tea?

    Served in small tulip-shaped glasses, often all day long. Çaycı = tea seller; çay bahçesi = tea garden. Another word çay means stream.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 1: Letters and sounds

  17. 917
    yazıkinterjection

    what a pity, too bad; poor thing (yazık ona)

    Gelemiyor musun? Çok yazık!

    You can't come? What a pity!

    Yazık ona = Poor thing; Yazık oldu = What a waste. Also a reproach: Yazık sana! (Shame on you!)

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 1: Unreal conditionals and wishes

  18. 918
    göğüsnoun

    chest; breast

    Doktor, göğüs ağrım var.

    Doctor, I have chest pain.

    accusative göğsü

    The ü drops before a vowel: göğsü, göğsüm. Göğüs ağrısı = chest pain.

    B1

  19. 919
    incelemekverb

    to examine, to look into; to study (closely)

    Polis kamera kayıtlarını inceledi.

    The police examined the camera footage.

    aorist inceler · present inceliyor · past inceledi · future inceleyecek

    From ince (thin, fine) + -lA: to look at closely. The e becomes i before -(I)yor: inceliyor. İnceleme = review, study.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 5: Formal Turkish

  20. 920
    tanıknoun

    witness

    Ben bu kazanın tanığıyım.

    I'm a witness to this accident.

    accusative tanığı

    From tanımak (to know). The k becomes ğ before a vowel: tanığı. Tanıklık etmek = to testify. Also şahit.

    B1

  21. 921
    ötenoun

    the far side, beyond; the other (öteki)

    Köprünün ötesinde güzel bir kafe var.

    There's a nice café beyond the bridge.

    Used like a place noun: denizin ötesinde (beyond the sea). Öte yandan = on the other hand; öteki = the other one.

    B1

  22. 922
    dağnoun

    mountain

    Dağın tepesinde hâlâ kar var.

    There's still snow on top of the mountain.

    Dağa çıkmak = to climb a mountain; dağlık = mountainous. Ağrı Dağı = Mount Ararat.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 3: The future

  23. 923
    dinlenmekverb

    to rest, to relax; to be listened to

    Biraz dinlenmen lazım.

    You need to rest a little.

    aorist dinlenir · present dinleniyor · past dinlendi · future dinlenecek

    Also the passive of dinlemek: Bu şarkı çok dinlendi (This song was played a lot). Dinlenme = rest.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 6: Must and need

  24. 924
    sorumluadjective

    responsible (for); in charge

    Bu işten kim sorumlu?

    Who's responsible for this?

    What you're responsible for takes the ablative: Bundan ben sorumluyum. Sorumluluk = responsibility. As a noun, the person in charge: mağaza sorumlusu.

    B1

  25. 925
    güneynoun

    south

    Yazın güneye, Antalya'ya gidiyoruz.

    In summer we go south, to Antalya.

    Güneyde = in the south; Güney Afrika = South Africa. Not güneş (sun).

    A2

  26. 926
    hamileadjective

    pregnant

    Ablam hamile, ağustosta doğum yapacak.

    My sister is pregnant; she's giving birth in August.

    Gebe is more formal or medical. Hamile kalmak = to get pregnant; Kaç aylık hamile? = How many months pregnant is she?

    B1

  27. 927
    gazetenoun

    newspaper

    Babam her sabah gazete okur.

    My dad reads the paper every morning.

    Gazeteci = journalist; gazete bayii = newsstand.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 6: The present continuous

  28. 928
    birincinumber

    first

    Yarışmada birinci oldu.

    She came first in the competition.

    Bir + -(I)ncI. Also top quality: birinci sınıf (first-class). İlk is also first, and more common before a noun: ilk gün (the first day).

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 11: Numbers and time

  29. 929
    dövüşmekverb

    to fight

    Okulda biriyle dövüştün mü?

    Did you get into a fight with someone at school?

    aorist dövüşür · present dövüşüyor · past dövüştü · future dövüşecek

    Reciprocal of dövmek (to beat): to fight with fists, with someone: ile. A row, with words or fists, is a kavga.

    B1

  30. 930
    bahçenoun

    garden, yard

    Bahçede domates yetiştiriyoruz.

    We grow tomatoes in the garden.

    Çay bahçesi = outdoor tea garden; hayvanat bahçesi = zoo; bahçeli = with a garden.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 5: Where things are

  31. 931
    tavsiyenoun

    advice; recommendation

    Sana bir tavsiyem var: erken yat.

    I have some advice for you: go to bed early.

    Tavsiye etmek = to recommend, to advise, to someone: dative. Bu kitabı sana tavsiye ederim = I recommend this book to you.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 6: Object participles

  32. 932
    aferininterjection

    well done, good job

    Aferin, bütün soruları doğru yaptın!

    Well done, you got all the questions right!

    Praise, usually to a child or someone younger; to a peer or someone older, Tebrikler or Bravo sound better. Said ironically, it stings.

    A2

  33. 933
    kızmakverb

    to get angry, to be cross

    Lütfen bana kızma, bilerek yapmadım.

    Please don't be angry with me; I didn't do it on purpose.

    aorist kızar · present kızıyor · past kızdı · future kızacak

    Who or what you're angry at takes the dative: bana kızma. The adjective is kızgın (angry); kızdırmak = to make angry.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 4: Verbal nouns

  34. 934
    boynoun

    height (of a person); length, size

    Boyun kaç?

    How tall are you?

    Uzun boylu = tall, kısa boylu = short (of people); boy boy = in all sizes; boyunca = all along, throughout.

    A2

  35. 935
    rolnoun

    role, part

    Bu filmde küçük bir rolü var.

    He has a small part in this movie.

    accusative rolü

    Takes front-vowel suffixes (TDK): rolü, roller. Rol yapmak = to put on an act; rol oynamak = to play a part.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 2: As if

  36. 936
    gözükmekverb

    to appear, to seem, to look; to be seen, to show up

    Bugün çok yorgun gözüküyorsun.

    You look very tired today.

    aorist gözükür · present gözüküyor · past gözüktü · future gözükecek

    Colloquial for görünmek: mutlu gözüküyor (he looks happy). Also to show up: Bir daha buralarda gözükme!

    B1

  37. 937
    bahisnoun

    bet; betting, gambling

    Babam hiç bahis oynamaz.

    My dad never bets.

    accusative bahsi

    The i drops before a vowel: bahsi. Bahse girerim = I bet (also iddiaya girerim). In formal Turkish also a topic: bahis konusu (in question).

    B1

  38. 938
    örneknoun

    example; sample; model, role model

    Bana bir örnek verebilir misin?

    Could you give me an example?

    accusative örneği

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: örneği. Örneğin = for example (more formal than mesela); örnek olmak = to set an example.

    A2

  39. 939
    kadernoun

    fate, destiny

    Buna kader derler.

    That's what they call fate.

    No vowel drop: kaderim. Kaderin cilvesi = a twist of fate. Also alın yazısı, literally what is written on the forehead.

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 4: Ottoman, Arabic and Persian structures

  40. 940
    özgüradjective

    free (not captive); independent

    Sınavlar bitti, artık özgürüz!

    Exams are over; we're free now!

    Free as in not captive or not controlled: özgür bir ülke. Free of charge is ücretsiz or bedava. Özgürlük = freedom. Synonym: hür.

    B1

  41. 941
    devletnoun

    state; government, public (devlet okulu)

    Babam bir devlet hastanesinde çalışıyor.

    My dad works at a public hospital.

    Devlet is the state; the government in power is the hükümet. Devlet okulu = public school; devlet memuru = civil servant.

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 2: -DIr: assumption and authority

  42. 942
    görüntünoun

    image, picture; footage, video; appearance

    Televizyonda görüntü yok, sadece ses var.

    There's no picture on the TV, only sound.

    From görmek (to see). Görüntülü arama = video call.

    B1

  43. 943
    ödülnoun

    award, prize; reward

    Bu yıl iki ödül aldı.

    She won two awards this year.

    Ödül almak or kazanmak = to win an award; ödül töreni = awards ceremony; ödüllü = award-winning.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 9: Everyday colloquial Turkish

  44. 944
    reddetmekverb

    to refuse, to turn down; to reject; to deny

    Teklifimi kibarca reddetti.

    She politely turned down my offer.

    aorist reddeder · present reddediyor · past reddetti · future reddedecek

    Ret (refusal) + etmek, written as one word with a double d. What you refuse takes the accusative: teklifi reddetmek.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 4: Noun clauses

  45. 945
    mavinoun

    blue

    Gökyüzü bugün çok mavi.

    The sky is very blue today.

    Like the other colour words, a noun and an adjective. Açık mavi = light blue; lacivert = navy blue.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 2: Vowel harmony and plurals

  46. 946
    tatilnoun

    holiday, vacation; day off, closing day

    Bu yaz tatile nereye gidiyorsunuz?

    Where are you going on vacation this summer?

    Tatile gitmek = to go on vacation; tatil yapmak = to take a holiday; resmî tatil = public holiday.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 7: To and from

  47. 947
    eğlencenoun

    fun, entertainment; party, festivities

    Düğünde eğlence sabaha kadar sürdü.

    At the wedding, the party went on until morning.

    From eğlenmek (to have fun). Eğlenceli = fun, entertaining; İyi eğlenceler! = Have fun!

    B1

  48. 948
    servisnoun

    service (in a restaurant); shuttle, school bus

    Çocuklar okula servisle gidiyor.

    The children go to school on the school bus.

    In Turkey a servis is also the minibus that takes pupils to school or staff to work. In a restaurant: Servis çok yavaştı (The service was very slow).

    A2

  49. 949
    enerjinoun

    energy

    Bugün hiç enerjim yok.

    I have no energy at all today.

    Enerji içeceği = energy drink; güneş enerjisi = solar energy; enerjik = energetic.

    A2

  50. 950
    eğitimnoun

    education; training

    Yeni işim için iki haftalık eğitim alıyorum.

    I'm getting two weeks of training for my new job.

    From eğitmek (to educate, to train). Eğitim almak = to get training; eğitimli = educated; uzaktan eğitim = distance learning.

    B1

  51. 951
    kızgınadjective

    angry, cross; red-hot (kızgın yağ)

    Neden bana bu kadar kızgınsın?

    Why are you so angry with me?

    Angry with someone: dative, bana kızgın. From kızmak (to get angry). Also very hot: kızgın yağ (sizzling oil).

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 3: Saying who you are

  52. 952
    cesaretnoun

    courage, bravery

    Bu iş cesaret ister.

    This takes courage.

    Cesaretli = brave; cesaret etmek = to dare (dative): Konuşmaya cesaret edemedim (I didn't dare speak).

    B1

  53. 953
    yaranoun

    wound, injury; cut, sore

    Dizindeki yara iyileşti mi?

    Has the cut on your knee healed?

    Yaralı = injured; yaralamak = to injure; yara bandı = adhesive bandage; yara izi = scar.

    B1

  54. 954
    biletnoun

    ticket

    Konser için iki bilet aldım.

    I bought two tickets for the concert.

    Gidiş dönüş bilet = round-trip ticket; gişe = ticket office, box office.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 3: The future

  55. 955
    adresnoun

    address

    Adresini bana mesajla gönderir misin?

    Can you text me your address?

    Ev adresi = home address; e-posta adresi = email address. Adres tarifi = directions to a place.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 9: Where and when: postpositions

  56. 956
    hanımnoun

    lady, woman (polite); Ms, Mrs (after a first name); wife (colloquial)

    Ayşe Hanım sizi bekliyor.

    Ms Ayşe is waiting for you.

    After a first name it is capitalized: Ayşe Hanım. Hanımlar = ladies; colloquially bizim hanım = my wife. Hanımefendi = madam.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 3: Saying who you are

  57. 957
    satın almakverb

    to buy, to purchase

    Sonunda yeni bir araba satın aldık.

    We finally bought a new car.

    aorist satın alır · present satın alıyor · past satın aldı · future satın alacak

    More formal than plain almak, and clearer when almak could mean to take. Satın alma = purchasing.

    A2

  58. 958
    tipnoun

    type, kind; character, guy (colloquial); look, appearance

    Ne tip müzik seviyorsun?

    What kind of music do you like?

    Colloquially a person, often with a judgment: Garip bir tip (A strange character); Tipine bak! (Look at him!). Not tıp (medicine).

    B1

  59. 959
    salonnoun

    living room; hall (for events); salon (hair, beauty)

    Misafirler salonda oturuyor.

    The guests are sitting in the living room.

    In a Turkish home the salon is the main room, where guests sit. Also a hall: düğün salonu (wedding hall), spor salonu (gym), kuaför salonu (hair salon).

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 5: Where things are

  60. 960
    rica etmekverb

    to ask (politely), to request

    Sizden bir şey rica edebilir miyim?

    May I ask you a favour?

    aorist rica eder · present rica ediyor · past rica etti · future rica edecek

    The person asked takes the ablative: Sizden bir ricam var (I have a favour to ask you). Rica ederim = You're welcome, the reply to teşekkür ederim.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 4: Noun clauses

  61. 961
    hayaletnoun

    ghost

    Hayaletlere inanır mısın?

    Do you believe in ghosts?

    From hayal (image, dream). Hayalet gibi = like a ghost (pale, silent). In folk tales also hortlak.

    B1

  62. 962
    sahteadjective

    fake, false, counterfeit; forged

    Bu çanta sahte, orijinal değil.

    This bag is fake, not the original.

    Sahte pasaport = false passport; sahte bir gülümseme = a fake smile. A fake designer item is also çakma (colloquial).

    B1

  63. 963
    çeşitnoun

    kind, sort, type; variety

    Bu dükkânda yüz çeşit peynir var.

    This shop has a hundred kinds of cheese.

    accusative çeşidi

    The t becomes d before a vowel: çeşidi. Her çeşit = all kinds of; çeşitli = various; çeşit çeşit = all sorts of.

    A2

  64. 964
    mantıklıadjective

    logical, sensible; reasonable

    Bu çok mantıklı bir fikir.

    That's a very sensible idea.

    Mantık (logic) + -lI. Mantıksız = illogical, unreasonable. Mantıklı ol! = Be reasonable!

    B1

  65. 965
    aşırıadverb

    too much, excessively; extremely

    Bugün hava aşırı sıcak.

    It's extremely hot today.

    Also an adjective: aşırı hız (excessive speed). In young people's speech, a strong intensifier: aşırı güzel (really nice).

    B1

  66. 966
    yenmekverb

    to beat, to defeat; to overcome

    Dün akşam babamı satrançta yendim.

    Last night I beat my dad at chess.

    aorist yener · present yeniyor · past yendi · future yenecek

    Who you beat takes the accusative: rakibi yenmek. A homonym is the passive of yemek: Bu mantar yenmez (This mushroom isn't edible). Yenilmek = to be beaten.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 3: Although, despite, without

  67. 967
    sağlıknoun

    health

    Sağlık her şeyden önemli.

    Health is more important than anything.

    accusative sağlığı

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: sağlığı. Sağlıklı = healthy; Sağlık olsun = Never mind (after a loss); Elinize sağlık = Thank you (to a cook).

    A2

  68. 968
    buznoun

    ice

    İçeceğime biraz buz koyar mısın?

    Could you put some ice in my drink?

    Buz gibi = ice-cold: buz gibi bir su. Buzdolabı = fridge; buz pateni = ice skating.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 6: Compound verbs

  69. 969
    bilimnoun

    science

    Bilim insanları yeni bir gezegen buldu.

    Scientists have found a new planet.

    From bilmek (to know). Bilim insanı (or bilim adamı) = scientist; bilimsel = scientific; bilim kurgu = science fiction.

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 1: Stacked modality

  70. 970
    yaklaşıkadverb

    about, approximately

    Yol yaklaşık iki saat sürüyor.

    The trip takes about two hours.

    From yaklaşmak (to approach). Also aşağı yukarı (roughly), or kadar after the number: iki saat kadar.

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 1: Stacked modality

  71. 971
    yüzbaşınoun

    captain (army rank)

    Yüzbaşı birazdan burada olacak.

    The captain will be here shortly.

    Literally head of a hundred. The captain of a ship, a plane or a team is a kaptan.

    B1

  72. 972
    uçnoun

    tip, end, point

    Kalemin ucu kırıldı.

    The tip of the pencil broke.

    accusative ucu

    The ç becomes c before a vowel: ucu, though most one-syllable words keep their consonant. Not uç!, the imperative of uçmak (to fly).

    B1

  73. 973
    hükümetnoun

    government

    Hükümet yeni bir karar açıkladı.

    The government announced a new decision.

    The government in power; the state is the devlet. Hükümet binası = government building.

    B1

  74. 974
    niçinadverb

    why

    Niçin bu kadar erken kalktın?

    Why did you get up so early?

    Ne + için, literally what for. A little formal: neden is neutral, niye casual.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 4: Questions and negation

  75. 975
    utanmakverb

    to be embarrassed, to be ashamed; to be shy

    Çok utandım, herkes bana baktı.

    I was so embarrassed; everyone looked at me.

    aorist utanır · present utanıyor · past utandı · future utanacak

    What you're ashamed of takes the ablative: Yaptığımdan utanıyorum. Utangaç = shy; Utanmıyor musun? = Aren't you ashamed?

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 8: Converbs II: the more, whenever, because

  76. 976
    gerekliadjective

    necessary, required

    Bu belge başvuru için gerekli.

    This document is required for the application.

    Gerek (need) + -lI. Gereksiz = unnecessary; gerekirse = if necessary.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 5: Formal Turkish

  77. 977
    sırtnoun

    back (of the body); back (of a chair), ridge

    Sırtım çok ağrıyor.

    My back really hurts.

    Sırt çantası = backpack; sırtüstü = on your back. The lower back is bel.

    A2

  78. 978
    şükürnoun

    thanks (to God); gratitude

    Çok şükür, herkes iyi.

    Thank goodness, everyone's fine.

    accusative şükrü

    Mostly in set phrases: Çok şükür (Thank goodness; also in answer to Nasılsın?), Allah'a şükür. The ü drops before a vowel: şükrü. Şükretmek = to give thanks.

    B1

  79. 979
    domuznoun

    pig, hog; pork (domuz eti)

    Çiftlikte domuz yok, sadece inek ve koyun var.

    There are no pigs on the farm, only cows and sheep.

    Domuz eti = pork, rarely eaten in Turkey; yaban domuzu = wild boar. Also an insult.

    B1

  80. 980
    isteknoun

    wish, desire; request

    Başka bir isteğin var mı?

    Is there anything else you'd like?

    accusative isteği

    From istemek (to want). The k becomes ğ before a vowel: isteği. İsteyerek = willingly; isteksiz = reluctant.

    B1

  81. 981
    oyuncunoun

    actor, actress; player

    Annem ünlü bir tiyatro oyuncusu.

    My mom is a famous stage actress.

    Oyun (game, play) + -CI: one word for an actor and a player. Futbolcu = soccer player.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 6: Object participles

  82. 982
    kapalıadjective

    closed, shut; off (a device); overcast (the sky)

    Pazar günü bankalar kapalı.

    Banks are closed on Sunday.

    Opposite of açık. Hava kapalı = It's overcast; Telefonum kapalıydı = My phone was off.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 4: Questions and negation

  83. 983
    aletnoun

    tool, instrument; device, gadget

    Bu alet ne işe yarıyor?

    What's this tool for?

    Alet çantası = toolbox; müzik aleti = musical instrument; elektrikli aletler = electrical appliances.

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 1: Stacked modality

  84. 984
    imzalamakverb

    to sign

    Lütfen burayı imzalayın.

    Please sign here.

    aorist imzalar · present imzalıyor · past imzaladı · future imzalayacak

    From imza (signature) + -lA. The a becomes ı before -(I)yor: imzalıyor. Also imza atmak (to sign).

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 2: -DIr: assumption and authority

  85. 985
    açınoun

    angle; point of view

    Bu açıdan haklısın.

    From this point of view, you're right.

    An angle in geometry and in photos (güzel bir açı); bu açıdan = from this angle, in this respect. Not acı (pain; bitter).

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 3: Complex nominalizations

  86. 986
    yargıçnoun

    judge

    Yargıç kararını yarın açıklayacak.

    The judge will announce the decision tomorrow.

    accusative yargıcı

    The ç becomes c before a vowel: yargıcı. Turkish courts officially say hâkim; yargıç is its Turkish synonym, frequent in dubbed films.

    B1

  87. 987
    tersnoun

    the opposite, the reverse (tersi); back, wrong side; wrong, opposite (as an adjective)

    Tam tersi, çok memnunum!

    Quite the opposite, I'm very pleased!

    As an adjective: ters yön (the wrong way); Ters giden bir şey var (Something is going wrong). Tersine = on the contrary.

    B1

  88. 988
    bıçaknoun

    knife

    Bu bıçak hiç kesmiyor.

    This knife doesn't cut at all.

    accusative bıçağı

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: bıçağı. Ekmek bıçağı = bread knife; çatal bıçak = cutlery.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 12: Requests and company

  89. 989
    önermekverb

    to suggest; to recommend; to propose

    Ne önerirsin, balık mı, et mi?

    What do you suggest, fish or meat?

    aorist önerir · present öneriyor · past önerdi · future önerecek

    To someone: dative, sana bir şey önereceğim. Öneri = suggestion. Close to tavsiye etmek (to recommend).

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 6: Object participles

  90. 990
    yetişmekverb

    to make it (in time), to catch (dative); to grow up; to grow (of plants)

    Trene son anda yetiştik.

    We caught the train at the last minute.

    aorist yetişir · present yetişiyor · past yetişti · future yetişecek

    What you make it to takes the dative: toplantıya yetişmek. Also to grow up (İzmir'de yetiştim) and, of plants, to grow. Yetiştirmek = to grow, to raise.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 7: Converbs I: when, by, without

  91. 991
    bozmakverb

    to break, to ruin; to spoil, to upset; to change (money into smaller notes)

    Yağmur bütün planlarımızı bozdu.

    The rain ruined all our plans.

    aorist bozar · present bozuyor · past bozdu · future bozacak

    Bozulmak = to break down, to go bad: Araba bozuldu. Para bozmak = to break a bill; bozuk para = coins, change.

    B1

  92. 992
    yerleşmekverb

    to settle (in); to move in; to fit in, to take a place

    Yeni eve yerleştiniz mi?

    Have you settled into the new house?

    aorist yerleşir · present yerleşiyor · past yerleşti · future yerleşecek

    From yer (place) + -lAş. Where takes the dative: İstanbul'a yerleşmek (to settle in Istanbul). Yerleştirmek = to put in place, to put away.

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 1: Stacked modality

  93. 993
    baskınoun

    pressure; printing; edition; oppression

    İş yerinde çok baskı altındayım.

    I'm under a lot of pressure at work.

    From basmak (to press, to print). Baskı altında = under pressure; ikinci baskı = second printing (of a book).

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 7: Discourse and argument

  94. 994
    kraliçenoun

    queen

    Kral ve kraliçe balkona çıktı.

    The king and queen came out onto the balcony.

    From kral (king). In chess the queen is the vezir. Güzellik kraliçesi = beauty queen.

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 2: -DIr: assumption and authority

  95. 995
    pencerenoun

    window

    Pencereyi açar mısın? Çok sıcak.

    Could you open the window? It's very hot.

    Pencere kenarı = window seat (on a plane or a bus); pencereden bakmak = to look out of the window.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 2: Vowel harmony and plurals

  96. 996
    köşenoun

    corner

    Eczane köşede, bankanın yanında.

    The pharmacy is on the corner, next to the bank.

    Köşede = on the corner; köşeyi dönmek = to turn the corner, and colloquially to strike it rich. Köşe yazarı = columnist.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 10: Whose is it?

  97. 997
    sinirnoun

    nerve; nerves, temper; anger (colloquial)

    Bu gürültü sinirlerimi bozuyor.

    This noise is getting on my nerves.

    Sinirli = irritable, angry; sinirlenmek = to get annoyed; Sinirim bozuldu = I got really annoyed.

    B1

  98. 998
    ahbapnoun

    buddy, pal

    Nasılsın, ahbap?

    How are you doing, buddy?

    accusative ahbabı

    Mostly in dubbed films, for English buddy or dude; friends in real life say kanka or dostum. Its older sense is an acquaintance. The p becomes b before a vowel: ahbabı.

    B1

  99. 999
    otobüsnoun

    bus

    Otobüs her yirmi dakikada bir geliyor.

    The bus comes every twenty minutes.

    Otobüs durağı = bus stop. Intercity buses leave from the otogar.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 2: Vowel harmony and plurals

  100. 1000
    sanatnoun

    art; craft (el sanatları)

    Ablam üniversitede sanat okuyor.

    My sister studies art at university.

    Sanatçı = artist; sanat eseri = work of art; güzel sanatlar = fine arts; el sanatları = handicrafts.

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 4: Ottoman, Arabic and Persian structures

About this list

The words are ranked by how often they come up in film and TV dialogue, so the list leans towards spoken Turkish. Words are listed in their dictionary form (verbs in the infinitive, gelmek), names and fragments are left out, and ranks are estimates rather than exact counts.

The order of the list is adapted from the 2018 Turkish list of FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, made from the OpenSubtitles2018 corpus via OPUS, and is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. The meanings, example sentences and notes are original to Daily Turkish.
